calls.title: PMM - Ashley: working session to prioritize enablement work
calls.summary: The team recognized an urgent need to progress the messaging framework, even as the product strategy and company positioning remain incomplete. Scott Bailey emphasized the importance of moving forward with messaging development and suggested revisiting earlier work on messaging pillars for relevance. Ashley Stirrup highlighted the close link between messaging and product strategy, noting that unclear messaging could cause anxiety among leadership. The team decided to pause the meeting due to a participant's emergency, agreeing to reschedule to ensure full engagement. They discussed using a Slack-based messaging framework to improve consistency and collaboration. The discussions revealed heightened sensitivity among leadership to messaging content, stressing the need for careful vetting before public dissemination, and they committed to an iterative approach for messaging development in parallel with strategy clarification.
calls.keywords: product strategy, messaging framework, enablement, positioning, messaging architecture, Slack collaboration
